name: adiabatic_humidifier_simplified
title: Adiabatic humidifier, simplified model (effectiveness-NTU)
summary: Adiabatic (evaporative) humidifier on humid air: heat and moisture transfer effectiveness from an NTU whose conductance follows power laws in the air and water flow rates (laboratory identification); exit air state and fraction of the supplied water evaporated.

origin.course: ULiège model bank (Laborelec toolkit lineage), RefSim reference-simulation model, 2008-01-03; listed as IEA ECBCS Annexe 43 PR2 A10 reference model

verification.reference: EES stored solution in the source file (25 common variables; 5 recovered by hand-decoding variable records skipped by ees_extract.py, bug CS-BUG-EXTRACT-FMT)
verification.notes: 25 common variables, 5 differ above rtol=0.001, maximum relative difference 4.42e-03 (humid-air property values w_su_hum, w_ex_hum, h_a_su_hum, h_a_ex_hum, eta_hum): within the 0.5 % expected between the EES and CoolProp humid-air formulations. Control-panel display variables without equations (M_dot_a, R, cp, su, AU_n, M_dot_a_n, M_dot_w_n, n, m) are not part of the comparison.
